_publications._context: Human lymphoblastoid cell line derived from an individual with NF1 (blood, EBV-transformed with cyclosporin A per Anderson & Gusella 1984). Carries NF1 variant c.2033delC, deletion in exon 18 (13) (p.R678fs*10), predicted to truncate the protein. No further clinical data are available for this individual. Synapse syn74552629; James Walker's group, Massachusetts General Hospital.

basicInfo.description: Human lymphoblastoid cell line derived via EBV transformation from the blood of an individual with NF1, carrying the NF1 variant c.2033delC (p.R678fs*10) (Deletion in exon 18 (13)).
